title: The mass gap over the compact simple groups
description: A manuscript deriving a mass gap for lattice gauge theory over every compact simple group, constructively over the positive naturals, together with its Lean 4 formalization: two libraries, MassGap and MassGapChecks, Lean core alone, every declaration at the empty axiom set and every check module decided by the kernel. The manuscript is a nominally complete proof, to the extent that any proof reviewed only by its author can be considered complete; any change, significant or minor, is made in the TeX first and reflected in Lean. The Lean tree is a mostly complete transcription of the TeX proof, and the README states exactly which clauses of the main theorem it holds at this version and which remain open.
